name: PulteGroup

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Pulte Group updated logo.png)

description: PulteGroup builds and sells single-family and attached homes in 47 markets across 26 states (1,014 active communities at 2025-12-31), aimed at first-time, move-up and age-55-plus buyers under the Pulte, Centex, Del Webb, DiVosta and John Wieland brands. Homebuilding made 98 percent of 2025 revenue ($17.3B total) and about 95 percent of pre-tax income; buyers pay the full price at closing, mostly with a mortgage. A small captive Financial Services arm originates mortgages for 64 percent of its closings and sells them on, and does title work. The 10-K puts its national share at about 4 percent of US new-home sales. 2025 closings fell 5 percent and gross margin from home sales fell to 26.3 percent from 28.9 percent.

businessLines.description: Acquires and develops land and builds homes in six reportable regions (Northeast, Southeast, Florida, Midwest, Texas, West) plus Other (land sales and construction services).
